title: Stairwell / Vanity / Wraparound (LIVC)
headline: Slimmer. Sleeker. Stairwell, vanity and wraparound fixtures that link like an LBI.
callouts: Uses the same seamless connector and linking cable as our LBI
Simple Lighting Controls | Networked Lighting Controls

features.label: FlexWatt selectable wattage
features.note: 10W/15W/20W/30W on 2 ft and 3 ft models, 10W/15W/30W/40W on 4 ft models; factory default 15W

features.label: Linkable from one power feed
features.note: connect up to 20 4 ft units together @ 120VAC or 40 4 ft units @ 277VAC; same seamless connector and linking cable as the LBI

features.label: Simple Lighting Controls / Networked Lighting Controls ready
features.note: see catalog page 25 or the product spec sheet on LED-LLC.com; RC-REMOTE-IR23 remote for microwave occ sensors
